title: Release a 2.5-inch drive from its pinned service bracket
instruction: Remove the disconnected drive from the pinned bracket and place it on the staging supports. Release the compliant rail and withdraw both grippers. The assembly is already removed from the computer.
context: Computer service technicians flex a removed drive bracket to release its mounting pins before lifting out the drive (Dell OptiPlex 7060 Tower service manual pp23-24). This benchmark isolates that mechanical step after cables and chassis assembly are removed.
setup: Standard YAM station, tabletop z=0.7475 m. Fixed original bracket fixture at (0.24,0,0.7975) m. The prepared drive case is 100 x 69.85 x 6.8 mm, center (0.24,0,0.8039) m. Two pins per side enter real 4.8 mm bores. The +Y side rail has a passive 0-7 mm spring-return joint and a compact authored 20 x 4 x 16 mm end tab beyond the drive end. It starts at rest, pins engaged. The disconnected drive is already installed in this bracket; no chassis access or electrical mating is scored. Staging supports center at (0.25,-0.19), top z=0.7725 m. All bracket/pin/bore/compliance/mass/material geometry is benchmark-authored; only the external drive envelope is manufacturer-dimensional. Complete collider and parameter tables are in scene.json and PARAMETERS.md.
scoring: 0.25 for a seated side-rail release of at least 4.5 mm; 0.5 for full physical extraction, plus 0.25 for rail return within 0.5 mm and 0.25 for staging within 1.5 mm lateral/0.5 mm vertical/0.025 rad. Full score requires 2 s stability below 8 mm/s and 0.15 rad/s and robot clearance 20 mm; otherwise capped at 0.95. Penetration above 0.35 mm, fixture movement, state replacement, invalid frames, joint violations or loss invalidate the trial. Valid alternate removal paths count.
run_limit: 6,500 control actions at 20 Hz (325 simulated seconds)
reset_notes: Seed 0, zero jitter. Restore all assembly poses, drive velocities and rail joint position/velocity to zero. Clear scorer initial-layout and stability state and controller/recovery state; repeat native probes twice after reset.
fidelity: Dell-grounded one-side bracket release and drive removal only. Samsung 870 EVO external envelope documented; original bracket, larger pin bores, end tab, masses and spring-return prismatic flexure are approximations. Bench fixture anchors the bracket. Cables/chassis access, electrical mating, production force, flexural stress and exact Dell compatibility are not modeled. Native/expert/Dream/hardware not run.
scores: Native expert: not run; Dream-1: not run. Ideal joint tracking is a synthetic CPU fixture.
